content.text: The difference between a sovereign store and a manual operation is not scale — it is [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-digital-product-stores-kyc-payments|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]. A manual operation requires your attention for every order. A sovereign store processes orders identically whether you are watching or not, whether it is midnight or noon, whether it receives one order or fifty simultaneously. NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-only-real|Why Payment]]s monitors the blockchain continuously. The webhook fires the moment a transaction receives on-chain confirmations. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook, validates the signature, confirms the transaction independently on the blockchain, logs the order to your [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-works-how-2|supabase]] database, generates a presigned download URL from Cloudflare R2 with a configurable expiry time, and sends the delivery email via Resend. The buyer receives their product before they have navigated away from the payment confirmation page.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

A sovereign stack is not just a collection of tools; it's a well-orchestrated system designed to give digital creators full control over their online stores, payment processing, and order fulfillment. It's built on free and paid tools that work together seamlessly, eliminating the need for manual intervention and ensuring that orders are processed quickly and efficiently. This architecture is particularly important in regions where traditional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or severely restricted, leaving creators to rely on manual processing, which can be time-consuming and prone to errors.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the heart of a sovereign stack lies the Cloudflare Pages hosting platform, which provides a secure and reliable environment for digital creators to host their online stores. Cloudflare Workers, a serverless platform, is used to handle backend logic, automating tasks such as order processing and payment verification. Supabase, a PostgreSQL-based database, is used to store orders, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 is used for file delivery. NOWPayments, a cryptocurrency payment gateway, handles automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, ensuring that creators receive payments quickly and securely.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors are unavailable or severely restricted. These creators often face significant challenges in processing orders and receiving payments, which can lead to financial losses and reputation damage. By providing a sovereign stack, COREMERCH empowers these creators to take control of their digital commerce infrastructure, ensuring that they can process orders quickly and efficiently, even in the face of restrictive policies and platform restrictions.
Manual order fulfillment can take hours, introducing errors and financial losses.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A sovereign stack consists of several key components, including Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, NOWPayments, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Each component plays a crucial role in ensuring that the architecture works seamlessly, eliminating the need for manual intervention and ensuring that orders are processed quickly and efficiently. By leveraging these components, digital creators can build a robust and scalable digital commerce infrastructure that meets their needs and helps them grow their online businesses.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign stack today, digital creators can start by selecting the relevant components, including Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, NOWPayments, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. They can then configure these components to work together seamlessly, ensuring that orders are processed quickly and efficiently. Additionally, creators can leverage the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which provides a pre-configured sovereign stack that can be deployed in just 48 hours, complete with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing before handoff.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

The most important question a reader would ask is: 'Can I automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms?' The answer is yes, by leveraging the webhook pipeline provided by NOWPayments, which triggers order fulfillment and sends download links to customers automatically. This ensures that creators can process orders quickly and efficiently, without manual intervention, and deliver digital products to customers promptly.

What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?

A webhook is an API callback that triggers a specific action, in this case, order fulfillment. It is used to notify the server of a new order, allowing the creator to automate the process of delivering digital products to customers. The webhook pipeline provided by NOWPayments ensures that the order fulfillment process is triggered automatically, eliminating the need for manual intervention.
Can I use Cloudflare Workers to handle backend logic?

Yes, Cloudflare Workers is a serverless platform that can be used to handle backend logic, automating tasks such as order processing and payment verification. This ensures that creators can process orders quickly and efficiently, without manual intervention, and deliver digital products to customers promptly.
How does Supabase store orders?

Supabase is a PostgreSQL-based database that stores orders, ensuring that creators have access to real-time data and can process orders quickly and efficiently. This allows creators to keep track of orders and customers, making it easier to manage their digital commerce infrastructure.
Can I use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery?

Yes, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 can be used for file delivery, ensuring that digital products are delivered to customers quickly and securely. This allows creators to deliver digital products to customers promptly, without manual intervention.
